description.en: The six-layer ontology: academies, teams, services, macro works, meta solutions and projects.
description.fr: The six-layer ontology: academies, teams, services, macro works, meta solutions and projects.
description.ar: The six-layer ontology: academies, teams, services, macro works, meta solutions and projects.

lead.en: Projects use meta solutions; meta solutions operate across macro works; macro works contain services; services are delivered by teams; academies form the competence teams need.
lead.fr: Projects use meta solutions; meta solutions operate across macro works; macro works contain services; services are delivered by teams; academies form the competence teams need.
lead.ar: Projects use meta solutions; meta solutions operate across macro works; macro works contain services; services are delivered by teams; academies form the competence teams need.

text.en: The ontology is a catalogue and a dependency map. A layer existing does not mean it is operating.
